title: 怎么 vs 怎么样 in Chinese: HSK 1 Grammar with Examples
description: When to use 怎么 (zěnme) and 怎么样 (zěnmeyàng): "how to" before a verb, "how come", "how is it", "how about", common mistakes and HSK 1 examples.
h1: 怎么 vs 怎么样: "How" and "How About"
lede: 怎么 (zěnme) and 怎么样 (zěnmeyàng) both translate as "how", but they sit in different places. 怎么 goes before a verb and asks how to do something, or why something is happening. 怎么样 usually comes at the end and asks what something is like, or what someone thinks of an idea.

sections.h2: 怎么 + verb: how to do something
paras: Put 怎么 straight before the verb to ask about the way something is done: how to read a character, how to cook a dish, how you are getting somewhere. In the answer, the method goes in the same place, before the verb: 你们怎么去？ 我们坐飞机去。 There is no 吗 at the end, because 怎么 already makes it a question.

examples.en: How do you read this character?
How do you make this dish?
I don't know how to say it.

paras: 怎么 can also ask why, when you are surprised or a little annoyed. It is often followed by 不, 没有 or 还: 你怎么不说话？ means "Why aren't you saying anything?". It sounds like "how come" in English. Later you will meet 为什么, the plain word for "why".
你怎么了？ is a very common question. It means "What's wrong?" or "What happened to you?" when someone looks ill, sad or upset.

examples.en: How come he didn't come today?

sections.h2: 怎么样: how is it, what is it like
paras: Put 怎么样 after the thing you are asking about to ask what it is like or how it is going: a new job, a film, the weather, a teacher. You can also say 你觉得……怎么样？ (What do you think of ...?). Answer with an adjective, usually with 很 or 太: 很好, 很好吃, 太贵了. 你怎么样？ on its own means "How are you doing?".

examples.en: What do you think of this top?

paras: To make a suggestion, say your idea first and then add 怎么样 at the end, like "how about it?" or "is that OK?" in English. To agree, say 好的 or 好.

examples.en: Let's go at three. Is that OK?

examples.zh: 我们坐出租车去医院，怎么样？
examples.py: Wǒmen zuò chūzūchē qù yīyuàn, zěnmeyàng?
examples.en: How about taking a taxi to the hospital?

examples.py: Hǎo de, wǒmen sān diǎn qù.

paras: The most common mistake is to swap the two words. 怎么 cannot end a question about what something is like: say 今天天气怎么样？, not 今天天气怎么？ And 怎么样 cannot mean "why": say 你怎么不喝茶？, not 你怎么样不喝茶？ A simple rule: before a verb, use 怎么; at the end of the sentence, use 怎么样.
Two more mistakes: putting 怎么 after the verb (你去怎么医院 is wrong; say 你怎么去医院), and adding 吗 to a question that already has 怎么 or 怎么样 (你的老师怎么样吗 is wrong).

examples.en: Why aren't you drinking your tea?

worksheet.title: 怎么 vs 怎么样 Worksheet: HSK 1 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 怎么 vs 怎么样 worksheet for HSK 1: 20 exercises (choose the word, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 怎么 or 怎么样
exercises.instructions: Write 怎么 or 怎么样 in each gap. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.en: What will the weather be like tomorrow?
Why aren't you eating?
What's your new teacher like?
How come she still isn't going to bed?
Let's go to the shop tomorrow. How about it?
How come you know my name?
Is this book any good?
Why aren't you at work today?
Why is none of you saying anything?

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: How do you get to school?
How do you write your Chinese name?
What's the food like at that restaurant?
How come you haven't gone to bed yet?
Let's go and have Chinese food this evening. How about it?
answers: 我们晚上去吃中国菜，怎么样？
晚上我们去吃中国菜，怎么样？

items.en: Mum, what's wrong?

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: Is this apple any good?
Why aren't you drinking any water?
How are you getting to the shop?

items.zh: 我们下午去看电影，怎么？
items.en: Let's go and see a film this afternoon. How about it?
answers: 我们下午去看电影，怎么样？

items.zh: 你的汉语老师怎么样吗？
items.en: What's your Chinese teacher like?
